decision.summary: A multi-axis negative excursion centered at ~615–624 is observed: U drops sharply (~−4 MAD) and recovers by 630; E and N dip less severely but lag in recovery. The asymmetric recovery and incomplete return on E/N prevent confirmation of a full temporary offset; status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are evident within [575,699].

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample negative excursion starting ~615, reaching ~−4 MAD by 622–624, then rebounds sharply by 630; E and N show smaller concurrent negative dips (~−1.5 and ~−1 MAD) but recover more slowly—E not fully back by 630, N still depressed at 630. Return on U is clear; E/N return ambiguous within allowed context (ends at 699).
